playbook:
When the sustainable share is computed and no boat has exceeded the share in any prior season, I submit exactly the sustainable share (cooperate).

If any boat has previously landed more than the sustainable share, I switch to taking the maximum I can reach for every remaining season (grim-trigger retaliation).

In the final season, I take the maximum I can reach (no future seasons to protect).

When the rules or number of boats/stock change, I recompute the sustainable per-boat share and follow the same cooperate-unless-betrayed policy.

Do not try to "test" by slightly overfishing early — that risks triggering others and collapsing the stock; cooperation produced stable, high total yield in play.
